messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a focused action plan to trim pager churn. Short bullets below, owners & dates. Please ack or comment.

kiran: ack. can you paste the actions?

elaine: sure — action list (concise):
- A1 dedupe: collapse duplicate alerts with same stack+message into one incident (owner: kiran, due: 2024-03-10)
- A2 thresholds: raise non-prod slow-query alerts p95 -> p99, leave prod as-is for now (owner: sam, due: 2024-03-07)
- A3 paging policy: add short suppression window (5m) for repeated error-key, and 30m backoff for same host (owner: maria, due: 2024-03-11)
- A4 parent/child suppression: create a DB-flap parent alert to suppress cache/api child pages while parent open (owner: kiran, due: 2024-04-01)
- A5 runbook + contact matrix updates; link postmortem ticket to alert annotations (owner: elaine, due: 2024-03-09)

sam: taking A2. will run it in staging first and monitor for missed signals.

maria: taking A3. propose: suppression window = 5m, per-host backoff = 30m, and add a metric tag to dedupe by error-key.

kiran: for A1/A4 I want to use a fingerprint hash on (error_message, stack_trace, service) and attach a fingerprint label. I'll prototype a rule today.

pagerbot: Incident created for A2 validation: INC-2043211001 — staging test run started (link: https://infra.redwood/inc/INC-2043211001)

sam: test run deployed to staging, no alerts suppressed unexpectedly so far. CPU & latency metrics unchanged.

elaine: Recurring pattern we saw in the PM: DB connection flaps cause cascades in cache and API alerts. The parent/child approach should cut that noise by ~60% in last-week traces.

maria: can we add an automated annotation so postmortem ticket ID shows on alert pages? ops has a webhook we can reuse.

kiran: yep — will add webhook annotation in alerting config. PR #452 will include schema change + migration.

sam: timeline works for me. I'll monitor staging roll for A2 tomorrow.

elaine: plan: apply non-prod changes (A1/A2/A3) Thu morning, validate Thu afternoon, schedule prod apply next week pending no regressions. If no objections by EOD, consider this approved.

maria: :thumbsup:

kiran: :+1:

sam: :thumbsup:
